rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for yoga as a Hindu or Buddhist discipline and exercise system.

example.english: I do yoga every morning, and I feel great after stretching.
example.traditional: 我每朝都做瑜伽，拉筋之後個人舒服晒。
